name: Cheapest-LLM Router
description: Routes any prompt to the cheapest reachable LLM (free tiers first, cheapest paid fallback). Returns chosen model, USD/CNY cost, fallback chain, reasoning, and how much it saves vs the priciest reachable model. Zero-dependency MCP server with 4 tools: route, cost_compare, list_models, cache_route. Reuses the free-model channels of Free & Cheap Tokens (FACT).
